title: SCR Unified Materials Catalog (Universal Sandbox & Simulation Semantics)
description: Unified semantic inventory distilled from universal materials across Minecraft, Terraria, and physics/rendering engines.

materials.name: Dirt / Loam
materials.description: Unconsolidated organic-mineral soil aggregate with moisture retention.

materials.name: Mud
materials.description: Water-saturated cohesive clay-silt matrix with low shear strength.

materials.name: Clay
materials.description: Hydrous aluminium phyllosilicate mineral aggregate with plastic deformation when wet.

materials.name: Sand
materials.description: Granular aggregate of weathered quartz particles subject to angle of repose and kinematic collapse.

materials.name: Gravel
materials.description: Unconsolidated rock fragments and pebbles exhibiting kinematic gravity and high permeability.

materials.name: Stone / Natural Rock
materials.description: Intact silicate/carbonate continental crust with compressive strength and brittle fracture.

materials.name: Cobblestone / Fractured Lithic
materials.description: Quarried and fractured aggregate stone assembled with frictional interlocking.

materials.name: Granite
materials.description: Felsic coarse-grained intrusive igneous rock containing quartz and feldspar.

materials.name: Diorite
materials.description: Intermediate intrusive igneous rock dominated by plagioclase feldspar and hornblende.

materials.name: Andesite
materials.description: Extrusive volcanic intermediate rock with fine-grained crystalline groundmass.

materials.name: Basalt
materials.description: Aphanitic mafic volcanic rock forming columnar joints with high compressive strength.

materials.name: Obsidian
materials.description: Extrusive volcanic glass formed by rapid quenching of felsic lava; extremely high blast resistance.

materials.name: Sandstone
materials.description: Sedimentary clastic rock composed of mineral particles and cemented silica grains.

materials.name: Marble
materials.description: Metamorphosed recrystallized carbonate rock with fine polish and subsurface light scattering.

materials.name: Slate / Deepslate
materials.description: Fine-grained foliated metamorphic rock characterized by high density and planar cleavage.

materials.name: Coal / Carbon Solid
materials.description: Combustible black sedimentary rock composed primarily of carbon with associated hydrocarbons.

materials.name: Iron
materials.description: High-tensile ferromagnetic transition metal forming foundational structural tools and armaments.

materials.name: Copper
materials.description: Ductile, malleable metal with high thermal and electrical conductivity, prone to verdigris patina.

materials.name: Gold
materials.description: Noble transition metal with high density, resistance to corrosion, and intense yellow spectral reflectance.

materials.name: Silver
materials.description: Precious metal exhibiting highest electrical and optical conductivity and highest reflectivity in visible spectrum.

materials.name: Tin
materials.description: Malleable post-transition metal with low melting point, used to produce bronze alloys.

materials.name: Lead
materials.description: Dense, soft, corrosion-resistant heavy metal with radiation shielding and radiation damping capabilities.

materials.name: Platinum
materials.description: Extremely dense, malleable noble metal with outstanding catalytic properties and corrosion immunity.

materials.name: Steel / Refined Ferrous Alloy
materials.description: Alloy of iron and carbon providing maximum structural tensile strength and fatigue resistance.

materials.name: Quartz
materials.description: Crystalline silicon dioxide exhibiting piezoelectricity, glassy luster, and high optical clarity.

materials.name: Diamond
materials.description: Allotrope of carbon in face-centered cubic lattice; highest hardness, thermal conductivity, and refractive brilliance.

materials.name: Emerald
materials.description: Chromium-bearing cyclosilicate beryl crystal with characteristic rich green vitreous luster.

materials.name: Ruby
materials.description: Chromium-doped aluminium oxide corundum crystal exhibiting deep crimson red transmission and high durability.

materials.name: Sapphire
materials.description: Corundum crystal colored by trace iron and titanium, used in scratch-resistant optical windows and instrumentation.

materials.name: Amethyst
materials.description: Violet variety of quartz irradiated with ferric iron impurities, producing geometric geode cluster formations.

materials.name: Hardwood / Oak
materials.description: Dense fibrous angiosperm cellular wood matrix offering structural load-bearing capacity.

materials.name: Softwood / Pine & Boreal
materials.description: Lighter gymnosperm coniferous wood rich in resins, easily worked for framing and cellulose pulp.

materials.name: Birch
materials.description: Fine-grained hardwood with distinctive white betulin-rich outer bark and light internal timber.

materials.name: Bamboo
materials.description: Fast-growing woody grass characterized by hollow internodal culms and outstanding longitudinal tensile strength.

materials.name: Foliage / Plant Canopy
materials.description: Thin photosynthetic leaves exhibiting high optical translucency, subsurface scattering, and low mechanical density.

materials.name: Bone / Osseous Tissue
materials.description: Rigid biological composite of hydroxyapatite minerals and collagen fibers with high compressive strength.

materials.name: Silk / Fibers / Webbing
materials.description: Polymer protein fibrils with extreme tensile strength, high elasticity, and dramatic kinematic velocity damping.

materials.name: Water
materials.description: Transparent Newtonian fluid with density of 1000 kg/m^3, low viscosity, and high specific heat capacity.

materials.name: Lava / Magma
materials.description: High-temperature molten silicate fluid exhibiting extreme viscosity, thermal emission, and severe destructive contact.

materials.name: Honey
materials.description: Supersaturated viscous non-Newtonian sugar fluid exhibiting significant velocity retardation and adhesion.

materials.name: Glass
materials.description: Amorphous non-crystalline inorganic silicate solid with high transparency and brittle fracture.

materials.name: Brick / Fired Ceramic
materials.description: Fired clay masonry block offering high fire resistance, compressive strength, and thermal mass.

materials.name: Concrete / Mortar
materials.description: Composite structural solid formed from hydration of Portland cement binder and graded mineral aggregate.

materials.name: Terracotta / Hardened Clay
materials.description: Earthenware glazed or baked clay matrix with earthy chromatic pigmentation and high thermal durability.

materials.name: Asphalt / Bitumen Roadway
materials.description: Viscoelastic bituminous composite yielding high tire traction and high velocity conveyance.

materials.name: Ice / Glacial Ice
materials.description: Hexagonal crystalline solid phase of water (Ih) with low kinetic friction and brittle fracture under impact.

materials.name: Compacted Glacial Firn / Packed Ice
materials.description: Sintered and compressed granular ice crystals depleted of air pores, preventing rapid thermal melting.

materials.name: High-Density Blue Glacial Ice
materials.description: Extremely compressed basal glacial ice with structural bubble exclusion and minimal surface friction.

materials.name: Consolidated Snow Pack
materials.description: Sintered ice crystal matrix with high porosity, high solar albedo, and insulating thermal resistance.

materials.name: Unconsolidated Powder Snow
materials.description: Loose, high-porosity dendritic snow crystals unable to support mechanical loads, producing sinking.

materials.name: Frozen Lithic Cryosol / Permafrost
materials.description: Soil, gravel, or fractured rock permanently cemented by ground ice at temperatures below 273.15 K.

materials.name: Limestone / Carbonate Rock
materials.description: Sedimentary carbonate rock composed largely of calcite and aragonite; precursor to quicklime and cement.

materials.name: Calcite Crystalline Carbonate
materials.description: Trigonal polymorph of calcium carbonate exhibiting strong optical birefringence and rhombohedral cleavage.

materials.name: Volcanic Tuff
materials.description: Pyroclastic consolidated volcanic rock formed from consolidated ash, shards, and lithic fragments.

materials.name: Vesicular Pumice
materials.description: Highly porous vesicular volcanic glass with density lower than water, granting buoyant flotation.

materials.name: Peat / Organic Turf
materials.description: Partially decayed accumulation of vegetable matter and sphagnum moss; natural carbonaceous fuel precursor.

materials.name: Podzol / Forest Humus Soil
materials.description: Highly leached boreal soil characterized by a bleached eluvial horizon beneath organic humus.

materials.name: Halite / Rock Salt
materials.description: Isometric ionic crystal composed of sodium chloride (NaCl); highly soluble in water, depresses ice melting point.

materials.name: Sulfur / Brimstone
materials.description: Bright yellow orthorhombic non-metallic crystal with low melting point (388.36 K), combustible with blue flame.

materials.name: Gypsum / Hydrous Calcium Sulfate
materials.description: Soft sulfate mineral capable of thermal calcination into plaster of Paris.

materials.name: Combustion / Volcanic Ash
materials.description: Fine particulate mineral residue of pulverized volcanic rock or completed vegetative pyrolysis.

materials.name: Banded Iron Formation / Hematite Ore
materials.description: Sedimentary rock matrix containing high concentrations of hematite and magnetite oxides.

materials.name: Copper Ore / Malachite-Quartz Matrix
materials.description: Mineral aggregate containing copper sulfides and carbonates embedded in silicate host rock.

materials.name: Bauxite / Aluminum Hydroxide Ore
materials.description: Sedimentary rock with high aluminum content consisting mostly of gibbsite, boehmite, and diaspore.

materials.name: Native Gold Quartz Matrix
materials.description: Hydrothermal vein quartz hosting micro- and macroscopic inclusions of native elemental gold.

materials.name: Bronze Alloy (Cu0.88Sn0.12)
materials.description: Classical structural alloy of copper and tin offering superior hardness and corrosion resistance.

materials.name: Brass Alloy (Cu0.70Zn0.30)
materials.description: Malleable acoustic copper-zinc alloy characterized by low friction against other metals and bright golden luster.

materials.name: Aluminum / Pure Light Metal
materials.description: Low-density post-transition metal with high specific strength and self-passivating alumina oxide layer.

materials.name: Titanium / Refractory Transition Metal
materials.description: Lustrous transition metal with low density, extreme tensile strength, and high corrosion resistance.

materials.name: Zinc / Galvanic Metal
materials.description: Diamagnetic metal with sacrificial anode galvanic properties and moderate melting point (692.68 K).

materials.name: Tungsten / Heavy Wolfram
materials.description: Ultra-dense transition metal possessing the highest melting point (3695 K) and high tensile strength.

materials.name: Lazurite / Ultramarine Silicate
materials.description: Deep-blue feldspathoid sodium calcium aluminosilicate containing sulfur ions producing historic ultramarine pigment.

materials.name: Topaz / Aluminum Fluorosilicate
materials.description: Nesosilicate mineral of aluminum and fluorine; Mohs standard 8.0 with high optical dispersion.

materials.name: Jade / Nephrite & Jadeite Aggregate
materials.description: Interlocking microcrystalline pyroxene/amphibole mineral fibers offering unprecedented impact fracture toughness.

materials.name: Amber / Fossilized Tree Resin
materials.description: Amorphous biogenic macromolecular polymer formed from fossilized plant resin; natural electrostatic charging medium.

materials.name: Phosphorescent / Luminescent Crystal
materials.description: Doped alkaline-earth aluminate crystal capable of storing photon energy and emitting sustained visible radiance.

materials.name: Tanned Leather / Animal Dermis
materials.description: Cross-linked fibrous collagen matrix yielding flexibility, high tear resistance, and barrier properties.

materials.name: Chitin / Arthropod Exoskeleton
materials.description: Long-chain polymer of N-acetylglucosamine forming rigid protective invertebrate armor.

materials.name: Natural Rubber / Polyisoprene Elastomer
materials.description: Hyperelastic hydrocarbon polymer exhibiting extreme reversible elongation and restitution (0.85).

materials.name: Hydrocarbon Wax / Beeswax & Tallow
materials.description: Lipid ester mixture solid at room temperature with low melting point (335 K), used as hydrophobic sealant.

materials.name: Pyrolyzed Biomass Carbon / Charcoal
materials.description: Porous black carbon residue derived from thermal pyrolysis of hardwood in low-oxygen conditions.

materials.name: Bryophyte Ground Mat / Moss
materials.description: Dense non-vascular photosynthetic plant carpet exhibiting high capillary moisture absorption and impact damping.

materials.name: Fungal Hyphal Matrix / Mycelium
materials.description: Vegetative fungal colony composed of branched hyphae capable of decomposing organic detritus with faint luminescence.

materials.name: Xerophyte Cactus Stem
materials.description: Succulent plant stem with thickened fleshy parenchyma storing water enclosed in tough waxy cuticle with spines.

materials.name: Crude Petroleum / Liquid Hydrocarbon
materials.description: Viscous liquid mixture of hydrocarbons exhibiting density lower than water (850 kg/m^3) and flammability.

materials.name: Mineral Acid / Corrosive Hydronium Solution
materials.description: Highly reactive aqueous hydronium solvent capable of rapidly etching and dissolving metals and carbonates.

materials.name: Water Vapor / Steam
materials.description: Gaseous phase of water formed by vaporization above 373.15 K with positive upward convective buoyancy.

materials.name: Ambient Atmospheric Gas
materials.description: Standard terrestrial gas mixture (78% N2, 21% O2); baseline drag and diffusion medium.

materials.name: Particulate Combustion Aerosol
materials.description: Colloidal suspension of airborne solid soot carbon particles and liquid droplets obscuring light.

materials.name: Volatile Methane / Natural Gas
materials.description: Light, colorless, flammable gaseous hydrocarbon (CH4) forming explosive mixtures with oxygen.

materials.name: Dry Concrete Precursor Powder
materials.description: Granular aggregate of pulverized Portland cement clinker and silica sand; subject to gravity until hydrated.

materials.name: Hydraulic Masonry Mortar
materials.description: Workable cementitious binder paste used to bind stones and concrete blocks into monolithic masonry.

materials.name: Silica Aerogel / Solid Smoke
materials.description: Ultra-low-density mesoporous synthetic solid with lowest thermal conductivity and Rayleigh opalescence.

materials.name: Thermoplastic Polymer / Polycarbonate
materials.description: Synthetic organic polymer capable of plastic flow when heated and rigid impact durability when cooled.

materials.name: Elemental Silicon / Polycrystalline Wafer
materials.description: Tetravalent metalloid semiconductor forming foundational substrates for microelectronics and logic cells.

materials.name: Chemical High Explosive (TNT / Energetic Solid)
materials.description: Stable chemical solid containing nitro-groups; undergoes rapid detonation producing supersonic shockwaves.
